entries.content: Client mentioned they initially attributed symptoms to 'just a phase' for several weeks before scheduling. Discussed how early intervention can sometimes prevent escalation. Client expressed relief at finally having support structure in place.

Mental health professionals typically look at several factors including duration, intensity, and impact on daily functioning. Changes that persist and begin affecting work, relationships, or self-care routines are generally worth discussing with a healthcare provider who can offer personalized guidance based on your specific situation.
